# Version 4.152.0
> **Skia m152 and Graphite bindings** · [NuGet (prerelease)](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.152.0-preview)

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.152.0/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.2.1/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.152.0 updates the engine to Skia milestone m152 and adds Graphite GPU backend bindings for Vulkan, Metal, and Dawn. Preview 1 also ships a backend-neutral async RequestReadPixels API, a new SkiaSharp.Vulkan.Silk.NET package, FreeType-backed font rendering on Windows Nano Server, and several native memory-leak and allocation fixes.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this preview line.*

## Engine

- **Upgraded to Skia milestone m152** — The bundled Skia engine now tracks the m152 branch, including subsequent upstream chrome/m151 and m152 stability fixes merged in during the preview. ([#4651](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4651), [#4568](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4568), [#4538](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4538))

## API Surface

- **Graphite GPU backend bindings for Vulkan, Metal, and Dawn** — New bindings expose Skia's next-generation Graphite rendering pipeline, letting consumers create Graphite GPU contexts across Vulkan, Metal, and Dawn. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#3968](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3968))
- **Backend-neutral async RequestReadPixels on SKImage and SKSurface** — A new async ReadPixels API reads pixel data from GPU-backed images and surfaces without blocking the render thread, across all supported GPU backends. ([#4545](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4545))
- **New SkiaSharp.Vulkan.Silk.NET package** — A dedicated NuGet package wraps the Silk.NET Vulkan interop layer, simplifying Vulkan context setup without custom P/Invoke boilerplate. ([#4527](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4527))

## Bug Fixes

- **Native use-after-free fixes in region, pixmap, and image APIs** — SKRegion.SpanIterator, SKPixmap.ExtractSubset/With*, and SKImage.Create's raster failure path could reference or leak native memory after the owning object went away. All three are now rooted or freed correctly. ([#4355](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4355), [#4558](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4558), [#4455](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4455))
- **Reduced allocations in hot text and rendering paths** — SKData.SaveTo, GetEncodedText, SKRuntimeEffectUniforms lookup, and HandleDictionary's skip-registration check all avoid unnecessary copies, allocations, or repeated reflection checks. ([#4550](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4550), [#4498](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4498), [#4512](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4512), [#4630](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4630))

## Platform

- **FreeType font rendering on Windows Nano Server** — Nano Server lacks the GDI font stack, so SkiaSharp now falls back to FreeType there, enabling text rendering in containerised Windows workloads that was previously broken. — ❤️ [@jeffska](https://github.com/jeffska) ([#4280](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4280))
- **Windows native builds no longer pin a fixed SDK version** — The Windows native build stops pinning a specific Windows SDK version by default, and now initializes the MSVC environment once per build for more reliable native builds. — ❤️ [@mmitche](https://github.com/mmitche) ([#4588](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4588), [#4570](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4570))

## HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.1

HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.1 ships with this release, carrying the same infrastructure and build hardening as the SkiaSharp preview.

## Preview 1 (August 5, 2026)

Preview 1 opened the 4.152.0 line with the Skia m152 engine upgrade, Graphite GPU backend bindings, the async RequestReadPixels API, FreeType support on Nano Server, and a round of native memory-leak and allocation fixes.
